name: @wootsup/anysource-mcp

tools.name: anysource_sites_list
tools.description: The configured sites: site_id, URL, platform, default and active flag. Pass site_id to FILTER to one. A call without site_id reaches active_site_id (use_site), else default_site_id; with several sites and none chosen, a write is refused (site_id_required), a read reaches the default. Ids from other tools are per-site, never global.

site_id.description: Only this site; omit for all.

include_meta.description: Rich-Card _meta payload; no host renders it.

tools.name: anysource_sites_test
tools.description: Test one site: calls the plugin's MCP endpoint with the key (initialize, then the health tool); returns plugin_reachable, bearer_valid. `site_id` is REQUIRED (anysource_sites_list).

tools.name: anysource_use_site
tools.description: Make a site the target of calls without site_id. With several sites and none chosen, a write without site_id is refused (site_id_required). Process-wide: other clients of this server share it, so pass site_id per call to keep them apart.

probe.description: Probe the site after switching; false switches without reaching it.

instructions:
# AnySource

Bring data from the services you use and from your own site into YOOtheme Pro through a saved flow (Source → Filter → Transform → Output). The AnySource plugin on your site answers every tool call.

## No site connected

No site is connected yet, so no plugin answers here. This server answers only anysource_sites_list, anysource_sites_test and anysource_use_site; its other tools appear after a site is connected and the AI client restarts.

Connect a site: run `npx -y @wootsup/anysource-mcp setup` in a terminal, then restart your AI client.
